tokens.name: bg-space
tokens.usage: Scene background and page ground. The Earth sits on it; nothing decorative is drawn on it.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Opaque control, diagnostics and timeline panels. Never translucent: scientific text is not read through imagery.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Hover fills, menus, tooltips, banners.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Input wells, segmented-control track, plot frames, tier cards.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and panel edges only (1.5:1 against bg-space; never the only boundary of a control).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries of inputs, sliders and secondary buttons: 3.7:1 on bg-space, 3.5:1 on bg-panel (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Values and labels. 15.9:1 on bg-space, 14.9:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Readout labels, captions, units of emphasis. 7.6:1 on bg-space, 6.6:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Units, sample stamps, help text. 5.2:1 on bg-space, 4.9:1 on bg-panel, 4.55:1 on bg-raised (lowest allowed surface).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text only (2.95:1 on bg-panel; WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for information.

tokens.name: accent-spacecraft
tokens.usage: THE accent: the spacecraft, its trajectory, the playhead and the single primary action. 8.9:1 on bg-space. Never used for status.

tokens.name: accent-spacecraft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on accent buttons.

tokens.name: accent-spacecraft-active
tokens.usage: Pressed accent buttons (on-accent text 7.0:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (8.9:1).

tokens.name: ref-analytic
tokens.usage: Exact analytic solution: dotted reference line and ghost marker. Never the integrator's output. 9.5:1 on bg-space.

tokens.name: tier-validated
tokens.usage: Evidence tier 1, Validated reference (border and icon). 8.6:1 on bg-space.

tokens.name: tier-tested
tokens.usage: Evidence tier 2, Tested condition (border and icon). 9.3:1 on bg-space.

tokens.name: tier-unvalidated
tokens.usage: Evidence tier 3, Unvalidated; also warnings. 11.7:1 on bg-space.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Impact and invalid input only. 6.4:1 on bg-space, 5.1:1 on its badge fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px keyboard focus outline, offset 2 px. 9.3:1 on bg-space.

tokens.name: badge-validated-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 1 badge fill (tier colour at 12% over bg-panel); text-primary on it 12.2:1.

tokens.name: badge-tested-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 2 badge fill; text-primary on it 12.1:1.

tokens.name: badge-unvalidated-bg
tokens.usage: Tier 3 badge and warning banner fill; text-primary on it 11.7:1.

tokens.name: badge-critical-bg
tokens.usage: Impact and error banner fill; text-primary on it 12.9:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind scene labels drawn over imagery, and over a dimmed (stale) result.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-sections, banner titles at 1.5x in presentation mode.

styles.name: panel-label
styles.usage: Panel titles, uppercase. Never for values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Semi-implicit Euler conserves angular momentum exactly.
styles.usage: Default UI and methodology text (methodology prose 16/26).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and readout labels. The smallest size for anything a user must read in a panel.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text, captions, legends. Never below 13 px in panels.

styles.name: readout-primary
styles.usage: Primary readouts (altitude, speed, period) in Explore; 22 px in Analyze.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Secondary and advanced values; typed fields.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Sample stamps, axis ticks, menu meta. The floor for any text: 12 px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls; label to control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; scene inset from viewport edges.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between fields in a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panel sections on the methodology page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters (methodology).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Plot frames, scene labels, keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, segmented items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, timeline, bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, slider thumbs, the play button, markers.

shadow.note: Hairlines, not shadows. The one shadow exists so floating overlays separate from the 3D scene.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips that float over the scene. Never on panels.

stroke.note: Scene line widths in CSS pixels, constant at every zoom (ADR-0005).

tokens.name: stroke-past
tokens.usage: Computed past trajectory, solid, accent.

tokens.name: stroke-future
tokens.usage: Computed future trajectory, dashed 6/5, accent at opacity-future.

tokens.name: stroke-analytic
tokens.usage: Exact analytic reference, dotted 2/4, ref-analytic.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: ECI axes, text-secondary at 60%.

tokens.name: marker-size
tokens.usage: Spacecraft disc diameter with a 2 px bg-space outline (constant screen size; labelled not to scale).

tokens.name: marker-ring
tokens.usage: Selection ring around the spacecraft: 1.5 px accent at 80%. Always drawn, so the craft is findable at any zoom.

tokens.name: velocity-arrow
tokens.usage: Optional velocity-direction arrow: 2 px text-primary, from the ring edge, direction of v at computed sample k. Direction only; no number derives from it.

tokens.name: crossing-size
tokens.usage: Analytical surface crossing: open diamond, 2 px ref-analytic. Distinct in shape and colour from the numerical impact cross (status-critical).

tokens.name: opacity-future
tokens.usage: Computed-but-not-yet-played trajectory.

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: A stale result kept on screen while input is invalid or a new run computes.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.
